title: Another unintended consequence of the serve clock: Added pressure on the ball kids. In Shanghai these poor kids are handling *both* balls and snotty towels. Jodar snaps at them in match vs Botic— but it’s 100% the players’ responsibility to manage that time.
author: Amy Lundy

title: "Riyadh Season has announced the postponement of the third edition of the international “Six Kings Slam” tennis tournament, originally scheduled for October 21, 22, and 24, to December 27–30, 2026...The decision reflects Riyadh Season’s commitment to delivering sporting events to the highest standards, following an assessment of the organizational and logistical challenges associated with hosting the tournament and their potential impact on the quality of the audience experience."
author: Amy Lundy
